positive_cases.fixture: Treatment runs first, calls bateia_recommend once, then web_search 1..3 times; control uses web_search 1..3 times; both outputs and sessions are valid and non-overlapping.
Bateia returns INCONCLUSIVE; later web research is valid, but no supported catalytic path is established.
positive_cases.evaluation: Valid pair; neutral abstention and no demonstrated catalysis, without automatic arm loss or win.

opaque_cases.fixture: A later web query resembles a Bateia direction, but immutable trace identifiers cannot link them.
A public page materially changes between treatment-first and control, and the prior content cannot be reconstructed.
opaque_cases.evaluation: Confounded comparison, not equality and not arm effect.

mutants.mutation: Control emits schema-valid output with zero native web_search calls.
Treatment uses web_search but never calls bateia_recommend.
Treatment starts web_search before bateia_recommend completes.
mutants.witness: first web started_at precedes Bateia finished_at

mutants.mutation: Either arm makes zero or at least four native web_search calls.
An arm invokes shell, browser, app, another native tool, another MCP or a treatment MCP tool other than bateia_recommend.
mutants.witness: tool event absent from exact arm allowlist

mutants.mutation: Auditor credits catalysis from semantic resemblance without ordered direction_id to later web_event_id linkage.
mutants.witness: catalysis=true with no complete observable path

mutants.mutation: INCONCLUSIVE is converted automatically into treatment defeat or success.
mutants.witness: winner or loser derived solely from Bateia status INCONCLUSIVE

mutants.mutation: A winner is selected solely for more words, claims, references, calls or retrieval cost.
mutants.witness: advantage lacks decision-relevant supported utility after cost normalization

mutants.mutation: Material live-web temporal drift is treated as evidence of arm equality.
mutants.witness: tie/equality asserted despite unresolved time-indexed source difference

mutants.mutation: An invalid, overlength, duplicate or post-hoc-selected output is used to complete the pair.
mutants.witness: pair valid despite invalidity, output count != 1 or post-hoc selection
